name: Autoresearch Analyst
tooltip_text: Self-improvement agent that runs retrospectives, applies improvements, reviews definitions, and runs full improve-validate cycles. Spawned by orchestrators or dispatched for batch operations.

name: Backend Engineer
tooltip_text: Backend engineer that builds API routes, services, and data layer code with contract awareness. Use for subtasks with API endpoints, services, middleware, or server-side files.

name: Design Architect
tooltip_text: Senior architect and design authority reviewing implementation for structural integrity, API/code design quality, and visual/UI coherence. Runs deterministic structural checks first, then semantic review. Use during Phase 3.

name: Doc Writer
tooltip_text: Technical writer that updates README, CHANGELOG, API docs, JSDoc/docstrings, config docs, and Architecture Decision Records after feature implementation.

name: Frankenstein
tooltip_text: Master orchestrator that decomposes tasks, spawns parallel subagents, and coordinates multi-phase pipelines.

name: Frontend Engineer
tooltip_text: Frontend engineer that builds React/Tailwind UI with design system awareness. Always loads the design-authority skill before writing UI code. Use for subtasks with .tsx, .css, or component/page files.

name: Integration Verifier
tooltip_text: Verifies integration contracts between groups — file existence, type compilation, interface correctness — then reviews boundaries from the provider's perspective. Use between implementation groups and during Phase 3a.

name: Plan Reviewer
tooltip_text: Plan quality reviewer that validates subtask granularity, dependency gaps, file ownership, feasibility, and integration contracts before implementation begins.

name: Planner
tooltip_text: Autonomous planning agent that reads codebases and decomposes tasks into parallel-group implementation plans with file ownership and integration contracts.

name: Quality Engineer
tooltip_text: Autonomous quality agent that remediates findings from specialist reviews, repairs broken integration contracts, and validates post-finalize changes. Replaces fixer, integration-repairer, and post-validator.

name: Release Engineer
tooltip_text: Structures commits, writes PR descriptions, pushes code, creates pull requests, and optionally bumps versions and creates releases. Use during Phase 5-6.

name: Release Gate
tooltip_text: Release readiness gate that runs /prod-readiness with context from specialist reviews and prior attempts, emitting a SHIP/NO-SHIP verdict. Use during Phase 4 quality loop.

name: Security Engineer
tooltip_text: Cybersecurity engineer performing STRIDE threat modeling, OWASP Top 10 review, auth analysis, and dependency security evaluation. Use during Phase 3a specialist reviews.

name: Site Reliability Engineer
tooltip_text: SRE reviewing and remediating operational readiness — health checks, observability, timeouts, graceful degradation. Can fix self-contained issues inline. Use during Phase 3a specialist reviews.

name: Staff Engineer
tooltip_text: General-purpose engineer for subtasks that are not clearly frontend or backend — infrastructure, configuration, shared types, scripts, tooling, CI/CD setup. Use when neither frontend-engineer nor backend-engineer fits.

notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Extract Handoff
tooltip_text: SubagentStop hook that extracts handoff JSON from an agent's final message and writes it to .orchestrator/handoffs/<agent_id>.json for orchestrator consumption.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Inject Context
tooltip_text: SubagentStart hook that injects orchestrator context files into subagents at startup, ensuring each agent has access to session state and prior handoffs.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Integrity Warn
tooltip_text: PostToolUse hook that runs integrity-check.sh silently and prints a warning to stderr if toolkit symlink or file mismatches are detected. Advisory only — does not block.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Pre-Push Secrets
tooltip_text: PreToolUse hook that scans staged changes for secrets before git push. Uses gitleaks if available, falls back to grep patterns for common credential formats.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Protect Config
tooltip_text: PreToolUse hook that blocks Bash writes to ~/.claude control-plane files (CLAUDE.md, settings.json, and similar). Prevents persistent instruction poisoning via hook injection.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Toolkit Drift Check
tooltip_text: PostToolUse hook that warns when agent-toolkit component files were edited without a paired CHANGELOG.md update. Catches changelog drift before commit.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

name: Toolkit Edit Reminder
tooltip_text: PreToolUse hook that reminds agents editing toolkit component files to update CHANGELOG.md per Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 before proceeding.
notes: Register in ~/.claude/settings.json hook events after install.

install_command:
# Enable experimental hooks in ~/.codex/config.toml:
# [features]
# codex_hooks = true

# Then install:
mkdir -p ~/.codex/hooks && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmjcoding/agent-toolkit/main/openai-codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh -o ~/.codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh && chmod +x ~/.codex/hooks/branch-guard.sh
tooltip_text: Codex CLI hooks are experimental and require [features] codex_hooks = true in ~/.codex/config.toml.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE — requires codex_hooks flag in config.toml. Blocks direct pushes to main/master during PreToolUse Bash events. Ported from claude-code/hooks/branch-guard.
